settings.relation: Soft, dreamy, soulful and meditative are all words that would describe Changeofcolours’ music. Inspired by her versatile inner world, the depth of her feelings, the beauty of nature and by life itself, she found with the handpan an instrument that makes it possible for her to express all that can’t be put into words. A big part of her music is improvised and thereby always created a new, out of the present moment.
settings.quote: When I heard and played an Ayasa for the first time, I instantly knew that I wanted my first handpan to be an Ayasa. Having a beautiful sounding instrument is absolutely crucial to me for wanting to play it as often as I can - and Ayasa is providing exactly this. I’m amazed again and again by the crystal clear, precise and warm sound of their instruments. And getting to know Ralf and the lovely team behind made me appreciate their incredible work even more!
settings.relation_more: With sharing her music she wishes to create a space for people to experience and get in contact with themselves and their own inner world. A space to feel, dream, open their hearts, simply be and arrive in a state of calm.
